subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A community that remembers past danger can prepare more wisely.”?
options: Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.
History carved in stone can become a warning for people who never saw the water rise.
Sometimes a mistake can become an idea if people are willing to look at it differently.
It was evidence that water remembers low places, even when people build new roads over them.
